text_block_list.text:
The student council is holding a meeting in
preparation for "Winning
Dream Stage," a
commemorative concert celebrating
development
and progress in the world of
Umamusume racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And that's all for the topics we have
concerning the upcoming event.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Эйр Грув. Well then, that
concludes our regular
meeting... and it's
already dark out.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Man, I'm hungry. That took forever.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Brian! What's with that tone? You'd think a
vice president would more
deeply
appreciate the significance of this event!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes... I understand you've been a bit
overworked, Brian. Hm,
we'll have to do
something about that...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Howdyyy! Air Groooove! I'll lend you a
hand!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Brian is such a stubborn sourpuss! If you asked me to help, I would finish everything in a snap! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Rudolf, is there anything I can do for the
commemorative concert?
Everyone is
looking forward to it, so I want to help.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
You guys! Heh... Hahaha! Well, the future
certainly looks bright!
You've paved us a
way forward!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone. With your goodwill
and cooperation, I believe
we'll make
speedy progress in our preparations!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
